candidate: Thirty independent in-battle belief searches; sum root visits; shared persistent public observer and belief; independent member RNG seeds drawn from agent RNG. Preview remains one tree.
provenance: The arena implementation shares the earlier allocation rule; its per-member seeds now come from a persistent agent RNG instead of reconstructing thirty ProtocolAgents. T11 and T26 must be rechecked with this implementation.

schedule.independent_unit: same teams and battle seed, two games with agent assignments swapped

analysis.estimand: candidate terminal score against current policy on the fixed meta pool, win=1, tie=0.5, loss=0
analysis.confidence: Normal approximation over side-swap pair means. Report 95% per-mode intervals and simultaneous two-mode 95% intervals using Bonferroni (97.5% per mode).
analysis.caps: Any turn cap invalidates the terminal-score gate; never count a capped game as evidence of a draw.
analysis.stopping: Complete all 256 games per mode. No tuning or optional expansion based on partial scores.

controls.null: Each identical-arm CRN duel must give score 0.5 with no split pairs.
controls.floor: Random agent is the intentionally empty policy; current and ensemble arms must beat it in separate controls.
controls.ablation: Current single-tree policy at the same total budget is the primary comparator.
controls.information: Blind ensemble must preserve behavior across the existing public-view-equivalent hidden-truth collision test.
controls.default_identity: Compare current default agent results with the saved pre-change arena executable.
